The '''Graveyard of the Dragons''' was a series of honeycombed [[Cave/Legends|caves]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xuaquarres]]. It was allegedly "[[The Graveyard of the Dragons]]," where [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuins]] went to [[Death/Legends|die]].
